Designed to deliver the unmistakable roar , sparkle , and dynamic touch sensitivity that players crave, tcd combines raw power with refined tonal sculpting . Whether you’re chasing articulate crunch, harmonically rich saturation, or soaring lead tones, tcd puts it all at your feet with intuitive control and Wampler’s signature attention to detail . A three-band EQ allows you to finally get the sound you want out of this circuit. The Mode switch lets you choose between two distinct flavors of clipping - when down it’s a traditional gain structure, when up it changes to a harder hitting and more tube-like sound with cascaded MOSFET gain stages. Inside The Compulsion Drive, you’ll find even more tone-shaping power waiting for you. A key feature of tcd is its ability to tap into classic flavors of the original circuit it was based on. Two internal DIP switches let you shape the pedal to your taste. The Fat switch adds deep low-end warmth for a thicker foundation, while the Diode switch shifts the gain profile with an extra clipping diode for tighter, more saturated distortion. These hidden options give the tcd boutique-level customization and serious versatility under the hood. $ 199.97 In stock tcd quantity Add to cart SKU: WMP-TCD-PED Category: Distortion / Overdrive Tag: distortion warning Cancer and Reproductive Harm www.p65warnings.ca.gov The Spirit of Distortion At the heart of tcd lies a circuit that has long been celebrated for its harmonic complexity and amp-like response. The Compulsion Drive comes alive under your fingers – cleaning up to shimmering grit when you back off, and exploding into searing distortion when you dig in. It’s the kind of pedal that responds like an amp, and it’s already a staple on the Wampler team’s boards. Timeless Circuits, Total Control The Gain control takes you anywhere from edge-of breakup crunch to roaring full-on distortion. Shape your tone with the powerful three-band EQ – Bass, Mids, and Treble – giving you everything from tight, focused drive to wide-open tones brimming with magical clarity and presence. Finally, the Level control delivers all the output you need, whether you want to push your amp harder or sit perfectly balanced in the mix. Responsive Grit and Power What sets The Compulsion Drive apart is its ability to feel like part of your amp rather than just a pedal in front of it. It enhances the harmonic content of your signal, allowing chords to shimmer with clarity and single notes to sing with sustain and definition. Pair it with other pedals and it unlocks entirely new shades of tone and harmonic richness. Crafted with Precision As with every Wampler pedal, The Compulsion Drive is built in the U.S.A. using only the highest-quality components. Every detail has been designed to ensure superior sound, reliability, and performance. Whether you’re in the studio or on the stage, The Compulsion Drive is ready to deliver night after night. sources.excerpt: Published on November 28, 2025 Wampler Pedals overdrive pedal Information The Compulsion Drive (TCD) by Wampler Pedals is a high-performance overdrive and distortion pedal designed by Brian Wampler as a refined reinterpretation of one of the most iconic distortion circuits in modern guitar history. Built to capture the dynamic response, harmonic richness, and amp-like feel of the original design, The Compulsion Drive merges raw tonal aggression with sophisticated EQ control. Its circuit architecture allows for a wide range of gain textures, from articulate low-gain crunch to harmonically dense high-gain distortion, while retaining exceptional touch sensitivity and note definition. A key aspect of The Compulsion Drive is its dual personality, achieved through its selectable clipping modes and internal customization options. The external Mode switch toggles between a traditional gain structure and a more tube-like configuration featuring cascaded MOSFET gain stages, offering the player distinct flavors of compression and harmonic response. Internally, two DIP switches provide additional tonal tailoring: the Fat switch introduces added low-end warmth, while the Diode switch engages an extra clipping diode to produce a tighter, more saturated gain profile. These options allow the user to access four different circuit variations directly within the pedal without external modification. The Compulsion Drive incorporates a full three-band active EQ section with independent Bass, Mids, and Treble controls, offering precise tonal shaping beyond what is typical of most overdrive or distortion pedals. The Gain control spans from edge-of-breakup drive to fully saturated distortion, while the Level knob provides ample output to drive amplifiers or stack with other pedals. The result is a harmonically rich, amp-responsive distortion tool that adapts seamlessly to a variety of guitars and amplifiers. Constructed in the USA using high-grade components, The Compulsion Drive features a rugged, road-ready enclosure with a premium metallic finish. Its design emphasizes reliability, low noise, and long-term performance, making it suitable for both studio and live applications. Wampler's attention to circuit detail and build quality ensures the pedal maintains clarity, touch response, and tonal consistency across all operating voltages from 9V to 18V DC. Controls Level: Adjusts the overall output volume; clockwise rotation increases output. Gain: Sets the amount of drive and distortion; clockwise rotation increases gain. Bass: Boosts or cuts low frequencies; clockwise increases bass response. Mids: Adjusts midrange frequencies; clockwise increases mid presence. Treble: Controls high frequencies; clockwise adds brightness and definition. Mode switch: Selects between two clipping structures. Down position delivers a traditional gain structure; up position engages a harder-hitting, MOSFET-based, tube-like response. Internal DIP switch 1 (Fat): Adds additional low-end warmth when engaged. Internal DIP switch 2 (Diode): Adds an extra clipping diode for a tighter, more saturated distortion tone. Connections Input: 1/4" jack for instrument input. Output: 1/4" jack for amplifier connection. Power: 9V-18V DC (center negative) input jack for standard pedal power supplies. Technical Specifications Power Requirements: 20mA at 9V DC, 25mA at 18V DC. Do not exceed 18V DC. Enclosure Dimensions: 2.5" x 4.8" x 2.3" (64mm x 125mm x 60mm). Build: Hand-assembled in the USA using high-grade components. Finish: Sparkle platinum enclosure. Warranty: Limited 5-year warranty for original purchaser. Highlights Reimagined version of a legendary distortion circuit with expanded tone-shaping controls. Switchable clipping and gain stages via Mode toggle for two distinct distortion textures. Dual internal DIP switches for additional tonal customization (Fat and Diode modes). Three-band EQ for detailed tone control across bass, mid, and treble ranges. Highly responsive to playing dynamics with amp-like touch sensitivity. Operates on 9V or 18V DC for variable headroom and feel. Built in the USA with premium components and rugged construction. Includes a 5-year limited warranty.
